meta.name: central-dome-right-wing-wireframe-labeled

mapPrototype2Reference.interpretation: Right wing is the longer Chemistry/Alchemy/Lab side in column J, extending farther south from the H6 dome core.
mapPrototype2Reference.modelScaleNote: Right wing total Z-span is 14.25m, divided into five 2.85m parts; the unchanged shoulder aligns to parts 2 and 3.

detailExclusionZone.reason: No windows or pilasters where the fixed shoulder attaches to wing parts 2 and 3.

wing.removedRightFrontPavilion: right_wing_terminal_pavilion removed; the front-right corner should remain part of the plain wing mass.

meta.designIntent: Separate right wing for the Central Complex. The wing is 2.5x the shoulder depth over Z, and the fixed shoulder aligns with wing parts 2 and 3 of five equal Z segments.

photoInterpretation.courtyardPhoto: Snowy plaza view of the right wing: longer and more repetitive than the left wing, with many inward-facing bay divisions and a heavier terminal pavilion at the far end.
photoInterpretation.modelResponse: Keeps the corrected wing footprint and shoulder gap clean, without a separate right-front terminal pavilion.
